name: @valuescan/copy-contract
description: TypeScript bindings for the ValuescanCopyTrading contract (UUPS proxy) on ValueChain: types, the committed ABI, calldata builders and view decoders, EIP-712 typed data for every ...WithSig action, event decoders and an event-sourced index with the stop-epoch rule, executor gates, execution-commitment Merkle trees, relayer helpers and TimelockController proposals. Pure TypeScript + @noble; no Node or DOM APIs; never sends anything.
